client_request_id.description: A new unique identifier for this request, for example a UUID. If the response is lost, send the same call again with the same value. Do not reuse the value for a different request.

context.description: Optional background text for the goal, for example relevant code, a local diff summary, or earlier findings. PostHog Agent cannot read local files.

goal.description: The goal for PostHog Agent, in plain language. Include what the user wants to know or get done, and what a good answer contains.

posthog_conversation_id.description: Optional PostHog AI conversation id from an earlier operation. Set it to continue in the same conversation. Omit it to start a new conversation.

project_id.description: Optional PostHog project id. The active project of this connection is used when it is omitted.

ref.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit in the repository. The default branch is used when it is omitted. The commit stays fixed for the whole operation.

repository.description: Optional GitHub repository in the format organization/repository. Set it when the goal needs the code. The project GitHub integration must have access to it.
